summary.text: Wayne Moyer is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania State Senate District 48 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as an information technology professional.

paragraphs.text: Wayne Moyer earned a high school diploma from Northern Chester County Vo-Tech, according to Ballotpedia, and advanced from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Moyer listed his campaign's key messages as getting ICE out of Pennsylvania, keeping decisions about women's health care in their own hands, and affordability, including help for first-time homebuyers and keeping water and sewer utilities public.
He also said he wants to grow high school vocational programs, keep data centers out of the state and expand the use of renewable energy.
